title: Allow refines hooks
body:
Most widgets doing refines should allow to hook into the refine function to allow use cases like:
- I want to know when the user selected a value
- I want to go to a specific webpage whent the user click on a menu item

This would also introduce an API similar to the queryHook on searchBox.

previous discussion: #791

comments.body: This will be available via connectors in react-instantsearch, soon in V2
